questions.question: After King Ahaziah of Israel was hurt in a fall, whom did he send messengers to ask if he would recover?

answers.text: Elijah the prophet of the LORD

questions.question: What did the LORD say through Elijah would happen to the injured King Ahaziah?

answers.text: He will heal in seven days

questions.question: When King Ahaziah sent a second captain and fifty men to Elijah, what happened to them?

answers.text: The fire of God consumed them
They ran back down the hill
The king called them back home

questions.question: When King Ahaziah's third captain came to Elijah on his knees, what did he beg for?

answers.text: That his life and his men's would be spared
That the king would be healed of his injury
That Elijah would leave the land of Israel
